title: Sr Analyst II IT Development
jobDescription:
Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software-defined future. Our state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. In 2024, we recorded annual sales of approximately $3.87 billion and secured $6.1 billion in new business.

• Develop, enhance, and support SAP ABAP programs, custom reports, enhancements, interfaces, forms and workflow using Modern ABAP techniques.

• Collaborate with functional teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

• Ensure coding quality, adherence to SAP best practices, and on-time delivery of development tasks.

• Support system upgrades, data migrations, and continuous improvement initiatives within the SAP ecosystem.

Key Performance Indicators:

• Timely and defect-free delivery of ABAP developments and enhancements.

• Adherence to coding standards and documentation completeness.

• Positive feedback from business and functional users.

• Number of successful deployments to production without rollback.

Key Year One Deliverables:

• Building reusable code modules and supporting system integration tasks.

• Deliver custom development required for support or rollouts timely.

• Maintain Documentation of Technical Specs and Unit Testing.

title: Technology Quote Lead
jobDescription:
Technical Quote Lead – Displays

Enabling a software-defined, electrified future.

Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here.

Mission of the ROLE: The Technical Quote Leader is responsible for leading new business pursuits/quotes for the Display product line and coordinating with all Display Product Line functions (Customer Regional Engineering, Mechanical, Display & Lens teams, Hardware & Platform Software teams, Program & Commodity Purchasing and Manufacturing) and lead & coordinate associated internal engineering activities. This role will have a clear understanding of why, what, and when of an assigned product and will communicate its story and the business value concisely to all stakeholders.

Typical Duties: Technical lead of Display related engineering activities for Customer RFIs & Quotations: Lead multi-functional global engineering internal team to Establish & direct engineering team supporting pursuits/quotes within the Displays Product Line.

Key Stakeholders: Multiple internal cross-functional stakeholders (example: sales, manufacturing, engineering); OEM customers; strategic suppliers.

Key Objectives of the ROLE:

  • Technical Lead for RFx Quotations:

    • Lead global engineering team.

    • Direct engineering team for new product line pursuits/quotes.

    • Review new product requirements (Mechanical, HW, SW).

    • Coordinate technical deliverables for quote timeline.

    • Develop optimal designs and review BOM costs.

    • Ensure timely completion of quote documentation (TDR, BOM, assumptions).

    • Work with Product Management & commercial team on cost targets.

    • Identify and initiate long lead items.

    • Align make/buy strategy with Manufacturing & Purchasing.

    • Review supplier quotes with Purchasing.

    • Optimize assembly process with Manufacturing.

  • Should Cost/Should Price:

    • Lead should-cost and should-price estimations (Display, Lens, e BOM, m BOM).

    • Review should-cost and should-price with stakeholders.

    • Collaborate with Purchasing and Customer Groups on cost/price targets.

    • Align strategies on winning cost targets and prices with related teams and management.

  • Process Compliance:

    • Ensure compliance during the quote process.

    • Support customer milestones and requirements.

Key Year One Deliverables:

· Strategic Growth: Develop strategies to expand Display products and increase market share.

· Should Cost and Should Price Management: Increase winning rate by estimating the cost and price precisely.

· Roadmap Validation: Continuously validate and adjust the product roadmap based on customer feedback and industry trends.

· RFQ Acquisition: Secure RFQs from auto OEMs to ensure significant lifetime value for the Display business.

· Technology Leadership: Introduce cutting-edge technologies to drive product and feature competitiveness.

· Cost Optimization: Create product value propositions and cost reduction proposals to optimize costs.

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:

Key experience required:

  • Years of Experience: 3+ years of Automotive Display product experience or similar;

  • Degree Strongly Preferred: Bachelor of Science (minimum), in Mechanical, Displays, or Electronic Engineering (EE), or a related field with equivalent experience.

Desired Competencies/Experience:

  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously;

  • Flexibility to support regions/countries in different time zones;

· Proven ability to lead and manage multi-functional global engineering internal team.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills with global cultural sensitivity.

· Strong presentation skills;

  • Ability to understand, at a high level mechanical, display design, electronics & associated implementation;

  • Good MS Office skills (Excel, Word, Power Point);

  • Good communication skills especially with Customers;

  • Ability to work within a constrained deadline (quotes are tight and time-bound);

  • Ability to work closely with suppliers for part selections and negotiations;

  • A Plus – deep understanding of displays & touch technology;

  • A Plus –understanding of commercial/business/financial measurement (NPV, IRR, EBIT, etc.);

  • A Plus – experience with Jira, Confluence and AI agents

  • Fluent in English;

  • Self-motivated with the ability to lead a global team toward a common goal.

  • Special Requirements (i.e. overtime, travel, etc.): Domestic and international travel to internal and customer locations may be required (~5-10%).

Key Behaviors:

  • Collaboration;

  • Result – oriented;

  • Critical thinking;

  • Evaluating problems;

Reporting Structure: Reports to the Associate Manager of the Display Quote team.

In the fast lane of technology. At Visteon, we’re redefining how the world connects through its vehicles. Our innovations transform the driving experience for millions, powered by a high-performance culture that challenges the status quo and sparks new possibilities—in careers and communities. Join us and help shape the future.

jobDescription:

  2. Architect and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins and Git Lab CI/CD.

  3. Lead and mentor the Dev Ops/SRE team, establishing best practices and engineering standards.

  4. Design and manage infrastructure platforms across on-premises and hybrid environments.

  5. Manage containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.

  6. Establish monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools like Prometheus and Grafana.

  7. Integrate security practices into pipelines, ensuring Dev Sec Ops compliance and vulnerability management.

  8. Drive automation initiatives to improve system reliability, deployment speed, and operational efficiency.

  9. Ensure high availability, performance tuning, and incident management practices.

  10. Collaborate with development, QA, and product teams to streamline release processes and improve delivery outcomes.

Additional RESPONSIBILITIES:

Required work experience

  • Years of experience: 6-10 Years

Key Performance Indicators:

  1. CI/CD pipeline reliability and success rate using Jenkins

  2. Deployment frequency and lead time for changes

  3. Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) and incident resolution efficiency

  4. Automation coverage across build, test, and deployment processes

  5. Reduction in manual intervention and operational overhead

  6. Pipeline performance optimization (build time, resource utilization)

Required Competencies:

  1. Strong ownership with ability to work independently and autonomously

  2. Effective planning, estimation, and task prioritization skills

  3. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability

  4. Continuous improvement mindset with focus on automation and efficiency

  5. Ability to collaborate across development, QA, and operations teams

  6. Strong communication skills (written and verbal in English)

Required Knowledge:

  1. CI/CD principles: Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Continuous Delivery, Continuous Deployment

  2. SCM tools such as Git, Git Lab, and IBM Rational Team Concert

  3. Containerization concepts using Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes

  4. Automation frameworks and integration approaches (REST APIs, SDKs, scripting)

  5. Software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Dev Ops practices

  6. Linux and Windows operating systems fundamentals

Required Skills:

  1. Hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline development using Jenkins (including pipelines and shared libraries)

  2. Strong programming skills in Python and scripting (Shell, Batch)

  3. Experience in developing and maintaining Jenkinsfiles and reusable pipeline libraries

  4. Proficiency in SCM and planning tools such as Git, Git Lab, IBM Rational Team Concert, and Jira

  5. Ability to design and implement automation using REST APIs and scripts

  6. Experience in deploying and managing CI setups across multiple projects

title: Software Development Project Lead
jobDescription:
Be a Part of the Technology Revolution

There has never been a more exciting time to be part of an automotive technology company like Visteon. No industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity than today’s automotive industry. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place. Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution. Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider solely focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry.

Key objectives of this ROLE:

  • Experience leading large design & architecture of automotive embedded products is preferred.

  • Knowledgeable in different products (Cluster, Display, ADAS).

  • Knowledgeable in large project management and delivery.

  • Work independently and collaboratively with multiple teams.

  • Communication with rationale and build consensus with stakeholders.

  • Prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Develop new approaches to complex design problems.

  • High level of domain expertise.

  • Lead overall project delivery and coordination across projects / multiple internal teams.

  • Leverage project management skills and understanding of multiple domains/technology to balance projects with varying schedules and priorities.

  • Sustain and lead efforts in High Level Design (HLD) through complete ownership and commitment to quality standards. Act as the single point of contact for all aspects relating to HLD.

  • Understand and review business requirements with the software delivery team, leveraging their knowledge of multiple domains.

  • Work on assigning the requirements between different tech teams internally, identifying the interfaces and dependencies. Work to ensure there is a clear channel of communication between teams to meet deliveries.

  • Work with the architects to define project-specific architectures. Understand and contribute to the technical solution from design through to code level. Analyze technical issues and guide the teams to find solutions.

  • Lead project-focused technical discussions between the domains and internal teams. Work with the integration and testing teams on triaging of defects with accurate assignment of defects and analysis of complex defects that would overlap multiple domains.

  • Work with external vendors/suppliers on tools and other software. Support supplier quality and assessments with other internal teams.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • On-Time Delivery: Achieve 85% or higher on-time delivery of customer milestones. Tracked on a sprint level.

  • Code Coverage Metric: Percentage of Code Covered by Testing, Maintain code coverage at 85% or higher. Regularly monitored during each development cycle.

  • Static Analysis KPI assessed at the end of each development iteration.

  • Global Team Collaboration: Frequency and Effectiveness of Collaboration with Global Teams

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent in Computer engineering, Electronics Communication Engineering or mechatronics or equivalent.

  • 10+ years of software experience.

Desired Competencies:

  • Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well.

  • Dedicated: Devoted to a task or purpose with loyalty or integrity.

  • Organized: Eye for detail and can put across ideas in a tangible form.

  • Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks.

  • Ability to Make an Impact: Inspired to perform well by the ability to contribute to the success of a project or the organization.

title: Manager, IT – BRM (HR)
jobDescription:
Mission of the Role

This is a hands-on leadership role for a practitioner who understands HR from the inside out. The Manager, IT – BRM (HR) serves as the primary technology partner to the HR function – someone who can sit in a compensation review or a talent calibration session, understand what’s being discussed, and translate that directly into system solutions. You will own the full HR technology stack, drive implementations, lead a small team of IT professionals, and act as the trusted advisor who bridges the gap between people strategy and technology execution.

Qualifications & Technical Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.

• 7+ years of progressive IT experience with at least 4 years in a hands-on HR technology role – configuring, implementing, and supporting HCM platforms (Workday, SAP Success Factors, Oracle HCM, Darwin Box, or equivalent).

• Demonstrated functional HR knowledge across at least three domains: talent acquisition, core HR/HRIS, compensation & benefits, payroll, learning & development, or workforce management.

• Proven track record of personally leading end-to-end HCM implementations or major module rollouts in a global, multi-country environment.

• Strong project and program management skills; PMP or equivalent certification preferred.

• Hands-on experience with HR system integrations, middleware (e.g., Mule Soft, Dell Boomi), and HR data reporting/analytics tools.

• Familiarity with HR compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, pay equity regulations, statutory reporting) and how they translate into system configuration.

• Up-to-date knowledge of HR technology trends including AI-driven talent tools, skills-based workforce management, and HR process automation (RPA/AI).

• Exceptional communication skills with the ability to engage credibly with HR business leaders and translate operational HR needs into actionable technical solutions.

• Continuous improvement mindset (LEAN/Agile) with a track record of simplifying HR processes through technology.

Key Accountabilities / How You Will Spend Your Days

Hands-On HR Technology Delivery

• Serve as a subject-matter expert and active practitioner on core HCM platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP Success Factors, Oracle HCM, Darwin Box)

• Lead and personally contribute to HCM transformation projects – from blueprint and design workshops through configuration, UAT, cutover, and hypercare – with direct accountability for system quality.

• Own end-to-end HR technology processes across the employee lifecycle: talent acquisition, onboarding, compensation, benefits, payroll, learning & development, performance management, and offboarding.

• Perform business process analysis alongside HR stakeholders, documenting current-state workflows, identifying gaps, and designing improved future-state configurations.

Deep HR Functional Partnership

• Partner with HR Business Partners, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, L&D, and Payroll teams – attending functional meetings, understanding operational pain points, and proactively proposing technology solutions.

• Act as the primary escalation point for HR system issues; investigate root causes, engage vendors as needed, and drive resolution with urgency and transparency.

• Translate HR policy and regulatory changes (e.g., pay equity, compliance reporting, new benefit structures) into system requirements and actionable configuration changes.

• Champion data integrity across HR systems – establishing data governance standards, audit routines, and remediation processes in collaboration with HR operations teams.

• Support workforce analytics by ensuring HR data structures, reporting hierarchies, and BI integrations are accurate, timely, and meaningful for HR and business leaders.

Project & Portfolio Management

• Manage the HR IT project portfolio with discipline: scope definition, resource planning, risk management, status reporting, and stakeholder communication – keeping projects on time, within budget, and delivering measurable outcomes.

• Define and maintain a rolling HR technology roadmap, prioritizing investments based on business value, HR strategy alignment, and total cost of ownership.

• Conduct rigorous cost-benefit analyses for new system investments, upgrades, and vendor decisions, presenting clear business cases to IT and HR leadership.

• Lead post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and continuously improve delivery practices.

Vendor & Contract Management

• Own vendor relationships for HR technology platforms and third-party integrations – managing SLAs, escalating performance issues, and negotiating contract renewals with a value-for-money mindset.

• Evaluate new HR technology vendors and solutions with structured RFP/RFI processes, personally assessing demos and conducting reference checks to make informed recommendations.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Lead and mentor a team of HR IT analysts and developers, providing technical guidance, code/configuration reviews, and career development support.

• Build team capability in HR functional knowledge alongside technical skills – ensuring the IT team understands what HR does, not just how the system works.

• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and learning from both successes and failures.

Technology Innovation & Process Improvement

• Stay current with HR technology trends – AI-driven talent intelligence, skills-based workforce tools, RPA, and employee experience platforms – and pilot relevant innovations in a structured, value-focused way.

• Identify and lead process automation opportunities across HR operations, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy.

• Drive adoption of deployed tools through targeted training, user enablement, and change management activities developed in close collaboration with HR leadership.

Key Performance Indicators

• 95% of projects delivered on time and within budget.

• Achieve a project success rate of 90% based on defined project objectives.

• Improve application uptime and availability.

• Reduction in application-related incidents by 20%.

• Adherence to the IT budget with a variance of less than 5%.

• Achieve a team satisfaction score of 85% or higher in annual surveys.

• Proactively identify and mitigate potential risks and vulnerabilities.

• Upgrade outdated, unsupportive IT Infrastructure & Software, supporting Finance and HR operations, with latest technology to improve system uptime and availability to 99%.

Key Year One Deliverables

• Complete a thorough audit of the existing HR technology landscape, documenting gaps, risks, and quick-win improvement opportunities.

• Establish a trusted partnership with the CHRO and HR leadership team, becoming the go-to advisor for technology decisions.

• Drive at least one significant HR technology improvement (e.g., HCM module implementation, process automation, or integration) from design through go-live.

• Publish a 3-year HR IT roadmap aligned to HR and business strategy.

• Implement operational governance practices for HR system support, change management, and release management.

Key Leadership Behaviors

• Lead from the front – models accountability, transparency, and a growth mindset for the IT-HR team.

• Stakeholder Management – builds deep trust with CHRO, HR Business Partners, and People leadership as a strategic advisor.

• Drives Innovation & Focus – champions AI, automation, and emerging HR tech to improve workforce outcomes and employee experience.

• Employee & HR Customer Obsession – places the employee experience at the center of every technology decision and service delivery model.

• Business Acumen – understands HR operating models, workforce economics, and people strategy to ensure IT solutions deliver measurable business value.

• Critical thinking & problem solving – applies structured analytical thinking to navigate complex HR technology landscapes and competing organizational priorities.

title: Workforce Planning Specialist
jobDescription:
Why This Role Matters:

At Visteon, we are reimagining how talent, cost, and productivity come together to power the business of the future. The Workforce Architecture team is at the heart of this evolution - shaping how work gets done and enabling leaders to make thoughtful, high-impact decisions on where to invest and how to unlock capacity for what matters most.

We are looking for a person who is energized by working at the intersection of data, strategy, and business impact. This role is for someone who is curious, analytical, and driven to solve complex enterprise challenges—translating insights into actions that meaningfully shape business outcomes.

What You Will Own & Lead

· Drive AI-Powered Workforce Transformation:

o Build and own a dynamic Role Risk Register, evaluating how AI and automation impact roles across the organization

o Turn complex data into clear insights that guide reskilling, redeployment, and workforce evolution

o Partner with Talent teams to future-proof critical skills and roles

· Workforce Investment & Un-investment Architecture

o Shape where the company hires, invests, or optimizes workforce capacity

o Evaluate new hiring needs against business priorities, internal talent, and automation potential

o Help leadership make high-impact decisions on cost, productivity, and talent allocation

· Build Forward-Looking Workforce Intelligence:

o Lead development of 12–36 months’ workforce forecasts integrating demand, skills, hiring, and attrition

o Provide regular insights on talent gaps, surpluses, and hiring priorities

o Create scalable analytics engines that improve planning accuracy and agility

· Enhance Organizational Effectiveness:

o Drive initiatives to simplify and optimize the organization—spans, layers, and role alignment

o Lead reviews that unlock productivity, capacity, and operational efficiency

o Translate data into clear recommendations leaders can act on immediately

What You’ll Achieve in Your First Year

· Deliver a complete AI impact assessment across all roles with actionable reskilling plans

· Build a workforce investment framework that identifies measurable optimization opportunities

· Launch a predictive workforce intelligence engine for long-term planning

· Drive organization design improvements that increase productivity and free up capacity

How Success Will Be Measured

· Full visibility into AI risk across roles with strong mitigation execution

· Tangible ROI and workforce optimization outcomes

· Improved forecasting accuracy (~±5%)

· Significant redeployment of talent to meet new business demand

What you Bring

· 10+ years of experience in workforce planning, resource management, or engineering operations

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (strategy, finance, analytics, or consulting background)

· Experience influencing senior stakeholders through clear, data-driven storytelling

· Ability to evaluate trade-offs, scenarios, and financial implications

· Focus on business outcomes (capacity, productivity, cost efficiency) over activity metrics.

title: Functional Safety
jobDescription:
Description

Be a Part of the Technology Revolution

There has never been a more exciting time to be part of an automotive technology company like Visteon. No industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity than today’s automotive industry. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place.

Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution. Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider solely focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry.

If you have experience in developing products at the system, software or hardware level, for industries such as automotive, avionic, medical, or train, and you are eager to grow your knowledge and expertise, then you are the right person! We are offering freedom for personal development and exciting career in the challenging area of automotive functional safety, a key feature of Visteon products (Instrument Clusters, Central Displays, Cockpit Domain Controllers, Battery Management System).

Your RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define and maintain the ISO 26262 safety process, reliability process, and supporting processes;

  • Conduct Functional Safety audits and assessments for engineering and manufacturing disciplines;

  • Perform independent confirmation reviews on safety-related work products;

  • Monitor correct implementation of safety measures in products;

  • Report functional safety development status of products;

  • Ensure the Functional Safety compliance of products;

  • Lead process and technical trainings;

  • Research, analyze and share information to Product Development organization about functional safety trends, and architecture solutions for products and elements.

Your QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Automation Engineering, or related;

  • Experience in specifying, developing or testing electronic products;

  • System design experience;

  • Experience in software design and hardware understanding;

  • Experience in Functional Safety is considered as a plus;

  • Good negotiation and persuasive skills;

  • Open for working in a multicultural team;

  • Fluent in verbal and written English.

More Good Reasons to Work for Visteon

Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world.

Company Culture

Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here.

Job Title: Global Software Quality Manager

Location: Chennai
Reports To: Director

Role Summary:

The Global Software Quality Manager is responsible for driving software quality excellence across global programs. This role ensures that customer requirements are met, internal processes are continuously improved, and quality KPIs are tracked and acted upon. The manager will lead quality initiatives, coach teams on problem-solving, and represent the organization during customer audits.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitor and analyze key software quality performance indicators (KPIs) across global programs, and define effective countermeasures to address deviations or risks in quality performance.

  • Plan and execute quality assurance activities for product changes, ensuring thorough impact analysis across software, hardware, manufacturing, and customer-facing functions.

  • Ensure that customer-specific quality requirements are fully understood, documented, and implemented throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Provide hands-on coaching and guidance to engineering teams on structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, Kenshokai, or 5 Whys, especially in response to development or field issues.

  • Take ownership of customer audits by preparing documentation, leading discussions, and aligning internal teams on quality-related expectations and corrective actions.

  • Investigate customer complaints and warranty returns by conducting root cause analysis and initiating structured problem-solving processes to prevent recurrence.

  • Lead internal initiatives aimed at improving software quality processes, tools, and standards, fostering a culture of continuous improvement across global teams.

  • Define measurable quality targets for products in production, and establish monitoring mechanisms to ensure ongoing compliance and performance.

  • Facilitate and lead lessons learned sessions across programs and regions, ensuring that insights are captured, shared, and integrated into future projects.

  • Track and manage design deviation requests, process changes, and special software releases, ensuring proper documentation, risk assessment, and approvals.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing, product design, and validation teams to prepare for product releases, ensuring all quality gates are met and release readiness is confirmed.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

  • Proven experience in software quality management, preferably in a global setting.

  • Strong understanding of quality standards (e.g., ISO, ASPICE, IATF).

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills.

  • Experience with customer-facing roles and audit processes.

We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Infrastructure Systems Engineer to manage, optimize, and evolve our global enterprise IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical skills across Windows and Linux platforms, VMware virtualization, enterprise storage, networking, across both on prem and public cloud environments. 1. Day-to-Day Infrastructure Operations

  • Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure high availability and performance of systems.

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between infrastructure teams, development teams, and operations.

  • Tackle complex tactical issues related to system performance, reliability, and integration across infrastructure layers.
    - Take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving infrastructure-related incidents, working closely with teams to address root causes and implement long-term fixes.
    - Lead efforts to optimize infrastructure performance and resolve operational challenges quickly to minimize downtime and impact.

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior technical team members by sharing best practices, architectural patterns, and knowledge from past projects.

  • Monitor infrastructure metrics, identify trends, and recommend improvements based on operational data.

  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Evaluate and recommend technology platforms, tools, and solutions aligned with enterprise needs.

  • Support hybrid cloud strategies, cloud adoption/migration efforts, and platform modernization initiatives.

  • Technology Evaluation and Innovation:
    - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and infrastructure best practices to optimize internal IT environments.
    - Introduce innovative approaches to streamline infrastructure operations and solve recurring technical challenges

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for infrastructure designs, implementation processes, and operational procedures.

  • Manage private cloud infrastructure (e.g., VMware v Sphere, v SAN, NSX) including automation, scaling, and monitoring.

  • Work with cloud networking, storage, backup, and security controls as part of daily operations and architectural planning.

4. Automation & Efficiency

  • Identify repetitive tasks and develop scripts/automation solutions (e.g., using Power Shell, Python, Ansible, Terraform).

  • Collaborate with IT operations, Dev Ops, application, security, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions.

  • Work across global, distributed teams to ensure alignment and consistency of infrastructure services.

  • Support digital transformation and cloud adoption initiatives with technical maturity and solution focus.

  • Storage: Strong knowledge of SAN/NAS platforms (Dell EMC, HPE, etc.).

Mission of the Role:The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. Functional Safety Lifecycle Management

· Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP.

· Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products.

· Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed.

2. Safety Analysis & Concept Development

· Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels.

· Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC).

· Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR).

3. Requirements Engineering

· Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements.

· Ensure bi-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation.

· Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements.

4. Hardware & Software Safety

· Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc.

· Support software teams in designing safety-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic.

· Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas).

5. Safety Analysis & Verification

· Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis.

· Calculate FIT rates, single-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics.

· Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system-level testing.

6. Audits, Assessments & Compliance

· Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews.

· Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors).

· Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434), and quality-compliance alignment.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes.

· Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management.

· Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

· Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle.

· Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA.

· Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, So Cs, and automotive ECUs.

· Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc.

· Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc.

· Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development.

Domain Knowledge

· Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems.

· Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM-specific safety processes.

· Experience

· 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems.

· Minimum 5+ years in Functional Safety roles.

· Experience delivering at least one safety-critical product to SOP.

· Preferred Qualifications

· Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida).

· Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R-Car, TI Hercules.

title: Sr Manager - SAP AMS

•Drive small enhancements and optimization backlog aligned with business priorities and IT leadership direction.

•Partner with Co E leaders, Site Leaders, IT Directors, and central process owners to ensure business continuity and improvement.

•Reduction in dependency on external partners over time.

title: Senior Technical Artist
jobDescription:
Mission of the ROLE:  Senior Technical Artist is a specialized professional who combines artistic and technical skills to solve complex problems in the fields of 2D & 3D GUI, animations, and visual effects. They bridge the gap between creative designers and developers, ensuring that the creative vision is implemented effectively in a technical environment. This position will focus on leveraging the knowledge of software, programming languages and technical tools to troubleshoot and optimize the assets, working closely with designers and developers to convert the creative vision without losing the design intent. The range of products in scope are Instrument Clusters, Head-Up Displays, and Infotainment systems.

Key Objectives of this ROLE:

  • Responsible for the implementation and optimization of UI Design related projects or aspects of the projects in defined scene composers.
  • Assure high visual quality and performance on the target hardware, by smart application and combination of tools and skills.
  • High independent communication with internal teams and external partners and customers.
  • Close collaboration with other Technical Artists, UI Designers and Graphic Engineers within the global design team and customer peers.
  • Support UI designers on asset setup, create and/or customize assets to fit defined implementation strategy.
  • Write performance optimized shaders in defined languages (e.g. GLSL) for materials, behavior and animations of graphical elements.
  • Support the integration of pre-defined plug-ins, materials, and effects from VFX library with support of more experienced Technical Artists and Graphic Engineers.
  • Work within defined toolchains and processes and focus on continuous improvements of the workflow
  • Grow and maintain effective partnerships with internal and customer UI Design groups
  • Asset Planning & Delivery support for Lead Designer through JIRA
  • Mentor Junior Technical Artists
  • Documentation for best practices.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Quality of technical solutions and documentation.
  • Committed deliveries on time
  • Scope clarification with Customer and clear conversion of the same as tangible requirements for internal stakeholders
  • Stakeholder satisfaction – Customer & Internal
  • Cross-team collaboration for effective outcome
  • Learnability for new tools and processes related to role
  • Mentoring of junior Technical Artists.

Key Year One Deliverables:

  • Roadmap Development: Define and document strategy roadmap with company objectives for the next 1–3 years
  • Design System Contribution: Establish or enhance a scalable design system to promote consistency and efficiency
  • Deliver technical solutions for assigned projects, validated by performance testing
  • Participation in all Customer meetings related to role and define the scope with action points
  • Mentor at least one Junior Technical Artist
  • Learning and adoption of Visteon JIRA - Agile project management toolchain.

Qualification, Experience and Skills:

  • 5-8 years of working experience as a technical artist in the gaming industry, user interface or preferably the automotive area
  • Expert skills in 3D modelling and 2D design tools, such as 3Dsmax, Maya, Blender
  • Expert skills with scene composers or gaming enginelike Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, KANZi, QT, CGI Studio, EB Guide, Altia or similar tools.
  • Strong expertise in Blender & Godot is advantageous
  • Expert skills in After Effects for motion graphics with Good Knowledge of Adobe creative suite (Photoshop, Illustrator etc.) is must Working experience with RIVE is advantageous
  • Furthermore, good knowledge in 3D poly modelling, texturing and animation would be required
  • Scripting in C# for custom behavior definition will be advantageous
  • Strong knowledge in shader coding (e.g. GLSL) and graphic languages, like Open GL will be advantageous
  • Affinity to new graphic rendering tools and languages, as well as technologies and willingness to apply these in the automotive context
  • Experience with JIRA is advantageous
  • Formal communication skills, including written, verbal in English is must
  • Communication skills in Japanese language will be advantageous
  • Familiarity with 4-wheeler driving & acquaintance with vehicle interior & controls will be highly advantageous.

title: Controller - Sr Analyst
jobDescription:
Overview:

As a Finance Controller, you will be responsible for overseeing the financial and operational control of engineering projects, ensuring alignment with budgetary goals, ensuring efficient resource allocation, cost management, and compliance with financial regulations. This role bridges engineering and finance, supporting decision-making through data analysis, cost control, and process optimization .

 

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

Financial Planning and Budgeting:

·        Develop and maintain budgets for the engineering sites.

·        Analyze cost variances and drive corrective actions

·        Collaborate with project managers and engineering teams to forecast financial needs and identify cost-saving opportunities.

·        Monitor budget performance and variance analysis, providing regular reports to stakeholders.

·        Support capital expenditure planning and tracking

 

Cost Control and Optimization:

·        Develop KPI to measure performance and cost optimization

·        Implement cost control measures to optimize expenses while maintaining quality standards.

·        Conduct financial analysis to identify areas for cost reduction or efficiency improvement.

 

Financial Reporting and Analysis:

·        Prepare financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements, to track performance accurately.

·        Perform financial analysis to assess project profitability, ROI, and financial health.

·        Present financial insights and recommendations to management for informed decision-making.

 

 

 

Compliance and Risk Management:

·        Ensure compliance with financial regulations, accounting standards, and internal policies.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

·        Collaborate with engineering teams, project managers, and other stakeholders to align financial goals with project objectives.

·        Provide financial guidance and support to Eng team, fostering a culture of financial responsibility and accountability.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

·        Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, Master's in Finance) preferred.

·        Proven experience in financial management, budgeting, and cost control, preferably within a engineering environment.

·        Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial data and provide actionable insights.

·        Knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and compliance requirements.

·        Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

·        Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

·        Proficiency in financial software and tools, such as Excel, SAP, or similar systems.

·        Attention to detail, accuracy, and the ability to prioritize tasks in a dynamic work environment.

 

This role offers a unique opportunity to leverage both engineering and financial expertise to drive strategic decisions and optimize the financial performance. If you are a results-oriented professional with a passion for finance and engineering, we encourage you to apply.
